candidates: When building argument arrays for subprocess or command execution (e.g. `executeCommand`, `spawn`), always push CLI flags and their values as separate array elements rather than as a single combined string. For example, use `parts.push('-p', String(port))` instead of `parts.push(`-p ${port}`)`. Passing a combined string like `"-p 6007"` sends it as one argument token to the spawned process, causing the flag to be silently ignored or misinterpreted by the target CLI.

Never use `console.log`, `console.warn`, or `console.error` directly in server-side code. Per project convention, use `logger` from `storybook/internal/node-logger` for all server-side logging. Remove any leftover debug `console.log` statements before merging; if the logging is genuinely needed, replace it with an appropriate `logger.debug` or `logger.info` call.
